d.title: One quantity under four names
d.caption: Entropy, cross-entropy, KL and information gain are the same machinery, and several questions here test whether you see that. Cross-entropy is entropy plus KL — which is why minimising a classifier's loss is minimising a divergence.

d.title: Population against sample, which most of these turn on
d.caption: Eleven questions, and the majority hinge on this one distinction. Every parameter has an estimator, the estimator has its own spread, and confusing the two is what produces the wrong answer about n − 1, about standard error, and about what a confidence interval covers.
